purpose: Hybrid RSA + AES attachment encryption per the new PhilHealth Guidelines PDF (received 2026-05-18). Supersedes Rounds 0-6 — all of those used symmetric-only AES with empty key1/key2/iv fields, which is the request-body envelope shape NOT the attachment shape.

scheme.rsa_padding: RSA_PKCS1_PADDING (PKCS#1 v1.5; fallback to OAEP-SHA-1 / OAEP-SHA-256 if rejected)

decision_table.All 5 PASS: Hybrid RSA-PKCS1 + AES-CBC-PKCS7 is the canonical attachment format. Codify into EncryptionService.EncryptAttachmentAsync.
decision_table.All 5 FAIL with key/decrypt error: RSA padding is wrong — re-try with --rsa-padding oaep-sha1 first, then oaep-sha256.
decision_table.All 5 FAIL with PKCS7-related error: AES padding may be Zero — re-try with --aes-padding zero.
decision_table.Mixed PASS/FAIL: Confirms the scheme; investigate the failing-file specifics (size boundary, MIME, etc.).
